followup.completionConsumer: Filter typed prefix before limiting the full service result; bind requests and display to exact UTF16 source plus caret.
followup.nestedControls: Split the same five source fixtures into separate tests with bounded per-key receipts; no assertions removed and no unproven dependency repair.
followup.boundedDiagnostics: Only known native error categories and reviewed source basenames/line numbers; no raw reason, raw logs, images or private paths.

limitations: Partial native success is not a successful workflow or a release gate.
Current published evidence cannot determine why the nested fixture loop lacked an end event.
New completion and per-key diagnostics require the next immutable native run.

postActionSourceDifferences.scope: Teardown compares against the earlier typed source; these passing tests intentionally rename or visually edit it.
